summary: Gamba Osaka 2026/27 home kit (hummel supplier). Front: Panasonic (chest), Daicel and Technics (collarbone area); back: Rohto (upper back, above the number) and SHIP Healthcare (below the number, back hem); left sleeve: Toyo Tires. Shorts and socks carry no sponsor logo. The right sleeve carries the J.League badge (league patch, not a club sponsor) and an OSAKA SUITA hometown mark; neither is recorded as a sponsor. All placements confirmed on the club's official 2026/27 uniform launch page.
